title: UAPI: _pad fields in sign/verify/agree not validated
description: crypto2dev_sign_op._pad[4], crypto2dev_verify_op._pad[4], and crypto2dev_agree_op._pad[4] are copied from userspace in ioctl_do_sign/do_verify/do_agree but never checked for zero. Without zero-validation these reserved bytes can never be repurposed: an old caller that passed garbage in _pad would not get -EINVAL, making it impossible to add semantics to those bytes in a future ioctl version without ambiguity about whether an old caller intended to set them. ioctl_init validates its _pad via memchr_inv; the same check is missing from the three asymmetric one-shot handlers. Fix: add memchr_inv(_pad, 0, sizeof(_pad)) checks in ioctl_do_sign, ioctl_do_verify, and ioctl_do_agree.
